scope: rg --files --hidden (repository nonignored text); excludes .git, dependencies, build outputs, credential files and ignored private/local runtime data
matching: case-insensitive literal substring, including identifiers; ordinary pass/password words not presumed stubs

reason_legend.1: Documented limitation, fixture, bounded unavailable state, ordinary language or non-authoritative DEMO context.
reason_legend.2: F4: provider SUCCESS promoted to analytical PASS without checking adverse economic effects; live equivalence stays false.
reason_legend.3: Explicit mode separation or fail-closed unavailability; not a missing implementation by itself.
reason_legend.4: Test-only fixture/adversarial assertion; not real provider capability evidence.
reason_legend.5: Dependency/package metadata; not an application implementation.
